reason: A payment-required refusal can coexist with a positive account allowance. Keep payment restrictions distinct from insufficient quota. Fast mode requires separate extra credits even when subscription allowance remains. An explicit image-preprocessing failure remains an image error even when the service stamps it with 402. Preserve descriptive quota reasons including remaining and required amounts in live and restored errors. Empty messages and bare error codes use localized wording.
